title: Unsupervised machine learning reveals prognostic value of dynamic carbohydrate antigen 125 trajectory in gastric cancer
summary: Four trajectories among 1,015 patients showed differing survival associations after stage adjustment. The trajectory-only model had a C-index of 0.74 versus 0.59–0.66 for one-time measurements in the same data. Retrospective single-center data with 7,347 measurements. The comparisons are within the cohort and do not establish external validity or a causal effect.
ai_technology: Unsupervised K-means grouped serial CA125 measurements into trajectories without survival or stage labels; subsequent survival models estimated associations.
